lecture_title: Closed Strings, Level Matching, and Duality

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_01.png
assets.rationale: Shows the canonical momentum and Noether-generator pattern used later for translations of the string coordinate.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: momentum times the change in the coordinate
assets.caption_hint: Canonical generator of an infinitesimal symmetry

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: Shows a complete closed-string contour with the arbitrary point sigma equals zero and the intrinsic orientation unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: we would mark it as sigma equals zero over there
assets.caption_hint: Closed string with a marked coordinate origin

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: Shows the periodic boundary conditions for both transverse coordinates after the loop coordinate is established.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: X of sigma plus two pi is equal to X of sigma

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: Shows the positive- and negative-index Fourier sums together with the center-of-mass zero mode.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the zeroth mode is just the center of mass
assets.caption_hint: Complex Fourier expansion of a closed string

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: Shows the completion of squares that separates total string energy into opposite running-wave sectors.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: one part is the left-moving energy and one part is the right-moving energy
assets.caption_hint: Chiral decomposition of the string energy

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: Shows the doubled creation operators for two transverse polarizations and two world-sheet directions.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: we have twice as many oscillators

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: Shows the four first matched products containing one oscillator from each world-sheet sector.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: one unit moving one way and one unit moving the other way

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: Shows the corrected circular-basis products and their helicities plus two, minus two, and zero.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: two units of angular momentum in the same direction
assets.caption_hint: Helicity content of the first matched level

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_09.png
assets.rationale: Shows the discretized loop and cyclic equality of wavefunctions under a common relabeling.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the wave function has to be invariant under cyclic permutation
assets.caption_hint: Cyclic invariance of the discretized closed string

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_10.png
assets.rationale: Shows the passage from a discrete cyclic shift to the continuous displacement sigma to sigma plus epsilon.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: shift sigma by a little epsilon
assets.caption_hint: Continuum shift of the closed-string coordinate

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_11.png
assets.rationale: Shows the unobstructed first-order expansion of the shifted wavefunctional argument.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: is this a separate equation for each sigma
assets.caption_hint: First variation under a common sigma shift

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_12.png
assets.rationale: Shows the integrated momentum-times-tangent generator after the wavefunctional derivative is identified with canonical momentum.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: integral P of sigma times X prime of sigma
assets.caption_hint: Generator of translations around the string

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_13.png
assets.rationale: Shows the sum and difference of the two chiral energies at the point where the generator becomes level matching.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the difference between them is this quantity which has to vanish
assets.caption_hint: Level matching as equality of chiral energies

assets.name: lecture_04_figure_14.png
assets.rationale: Shows electric and magnetic charges and the Dirac quantization condition during the strong-weak duality discussion.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: electric charge times magnetic charge is two pi
